about: During an air raid, 16 year old Noah and his little sister Renie seek shelter in a bunker. There, they not only are protected from the deadly bombardment, but also the crossroads of a world between life and death: Silence. When Noah loses his sister to Silence, he's forced to venture into this idyllic yet threatening world to find her. Silence, however, bears its own scars of war and suffering.

Join Noah and Renie on their exciting journey through Silence where an emotionally gripping story of contrasts between serenity and danger unfolds. Meet fascinating and likeable characters like Spot, the magical caterpillar who helps Noah and Renie on their way through Silence. And witness when the siblings discover, that the only thing that can save them is their love for each other.
Additional hardware required for Remote Play.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
